name: Bogan Flats Campground
evidence: Satellite 39.099,-107.258 + 39.1008,-107.2625: Crystal River 20-26 m on 5 transects, under 30 m. Pads 21 (46 ft), 24 (31), 25 (55), 26 (32) ~15-25 m from water; rec.gov site photos 25, 26 and 18 show the river right behind the table.

name: Lone Rock Campground
evidence: Satellite 39.252,-105.2355 + 39.251,-105.2345: South Platte 27-36 m on 5 transects (~30, far bank in shadow). Sites 9, 10 (25 ft) ~22-38 m across open grass and a thin low bank strip, no road between; FS: river access, views. Rec.gov has no site photos.

name: Spillway Campground
evidence: Satellite 38.9065,-105.469 + 38.906,-105.4695: South Platte tailwater below the dam 12-24 m on 4 transects, under 30 m; river value only. RV sites 14, 19 (35 ft), 21 (25) ~30-37 m over open ground and a low willow fringe, no road between; rec.gov photo 14 shows the river. Sites 8, 9, 19, 23 have no photo.

name: Mogote Campground
evidence: Satellite 37.064,-106.2345 + 37.063,-106.2365: Conejos 18-31 m on 6 transects, ~20 m at sites 29-30, widest only downstream of them. Lower Loop 29 (50 ft), 30 (40) ~25-35 m over open ground; rec.gov photo 30 shows the river across grass. Catalog tags all 40 sites Riverfront, Upper Loop 150 m+ back, so the tag is type-level and decides nothing.

name: Palisade Campground
evidence: Satellite 37.7515,-106.7658 + 37.7506,-106.7648 + 37.75,-106.7625: Rio Grande 28-43 m on 6 transects, mostly 33+. River-side spurs ~18-25 m from the bank over open ground with scattered spruce, no road between; rail and CO-149 lie on the far side. FS page: 12 FCFS sites, spur to 35 ft; no site map or photos.

name: Cañon Bonito RV & Fisherman's Club
evidence: Satellite 37.0482,-106.131 + 37.049,-106.1285: Conejos 15-21 m on 5 transects, creek by size. Operator map + photos: only the southernmost pad (site 21 by photo, inferred) reaches it, ~25-30 m by an open dirt corridor crossing a narrow trail; sites 1-8, 22-24 show no water in photos. One inferred pad, held at riverview.

name: Drake Campground
evidence: Satellite 40.433,-105.3395: channels here 8-12 m wet, ~15 m cobble bed, on 3 transects, far under 30 m. Row of RVs on open ground ~15-20 m from the north channel, no road or screen between. No website or site catalog; rig fit read from the trailers parked in the row.

name: Meeker Town Park
evidence: Satellite 40.035,-107.9112: White River 17-28 m wet and cobble on 4 transects along the RV lot (wider only below the bridge). Paved lot edge ~22-26 m from the water, but a town-park lawn and paved path lie between (day use), so not on-water; open view holds. Town parks page refused (406), stalls not confirmed.
